title: Formation of the East African Rift
summary: The East African Rift formed in the Miocene, roughly 25 million years ago, starting at the Afar triple junction in Ethiopia and extending southward over time. Its eastern branch through Ethiopia and Kenya is thought to have formed first; the western branch from Uganda to Malawi came later.

uncertainty.note: Geological Society says approximately 25 million years ago; the Springer chapter gives Late Oligocene to Early Miocene without numbers. The margin is a placeholder.
